file:app.py.name: app.py
file:app.py.summary: Flask application factory that configures the database, registers all route blueprints, and creates tables on startup.

file:models.py.name: models.py
file:models.py.summary: Defines the SQLAlchemy ORM data model: Users, Songs, Tags, ListeningEvents, Ratings, Playlists, Notifications.

file:seed_data.py.name: seed_data.py
file:seed_data.py.summary: Standalone script that resets and seeds the database with sample data.

file:services/playlist_service.py.name: playlist_service.py
file:services/playlist_service.py.summary: Playlist creation and retrieval logic. Note: get_playlist_songs returns songs[:-1], silently dropping the last song — a suspected bug.

file:services/streak_service.py.name: streak_service.py
file:services/streak_service.py.summary: Listening-streak logic. Note: update_listening_streak only increments on consecutive days if today.weekday() != 6 (Sunday), so a consecutive listen on Sunday resets the streak instead of incrementing — a suspected bug.

file:tests/test_playlists.py.name: test_playlists.py
file:tests/test_playlists.py.summary: Pytest suite for the playlist service.

file:tests/test_streaks.py.name: test_streaks.py
file:tests/test_streaks.py.summary: Pytest suite for the streak service, including test_streak_increments_on_sunday which targets the Sunday bug.

file:routes/playlists.py.name: playlists.py
file:routes/playlists.py.summary: Flask blueprint exposing playlist HTTP routes.

file:routes/users.py.name: users.py
file:routes/users.py.summary: Flask blueprint exposing user-related HTTP routes.

file:services/notification_service.py.name: notification_service.py
file:services/notification_service.py.summary: Notification creation/retrieval, adding songs to playlists, and saving song ratings. Note: rate_song does not create a notification when a song is rated, unlike add_to_playlist — a suspected bug (issue #4 in README).

file:routes/songs.py.name: songs.py
file:routes/songs.py.summary: Flask blueprint for song-related HTTP routes: search, detail, rating, listen-tracking.

file:services/search_service.py.name: search_service.py
file:services/search_service.py.summary: Song search and lookup logic. Note: search_songs does an outerjoin against song_tags without .distinct(), producing duplicate rows for multi-tag songs — a suspected bug (issue #3 in README).

file:tests/test_search.py.name: test_search.py
file:tests/test_search.py.summary: Pytest suite for the search service covering duplicate-prevention behavior.
